name: Chromatic Dragon, Brown
body:
NE dragon (earth, water)

BASE STATISTICS

Subpages

CR 4; Size Small; Hit Dice 5d12
Speed 40 ft., swim 40 ft., burrow 40 ft.
Natural Armor +4; Breath Weapon cone, 2d6 bludgeoning plus muddy terrain
Str 12, Dex 15, Con 14, Int 11, Wis 10, Cha 10

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and tropical tidal flats
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Enliven Mud (Su)

A great wyrm brown dragon can imbue mud with a life of its own. The dragon can awaken any 5 foot square patch of mud to become a greater mud elemental. A brown dragon can create a single greater mud elemental as a standard action, up to a total of 3 mud elementals per day. These elementals remain animated for up to 1 hour, at which time they revert to being ordinary mud.

Muddy Breath Weapon

A brown dragon breathes a cone of mud with great concussive force. In addition to bludgeoning damage, the area of the breath weapon becomes difficult terrain.

Quagmire (Su)

An ancient or older brown dragon can create a pool of mud as a standard action that automatically slows all creatures (except the dragon). This pool moves with the dragon and has a radius of 30 feet. There is no save for this effect, although the effect ends 1 round after leaving the brown dragon’s quagmire effect. Large amounts of running water (such as from a stream or river) disperses the defensive quagmire in 1 round.

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

A brown dragon gains the following spell-like abilities, usable at will upon reaching the listed age category. Young—mud ball; Juvenile—soften earth and stone; Adult—soothing mud; Old—slowing mud; Ancient—transmute rock to mud; Great wyrm—transmute mud to rock.

Swamp Stride (Ex)

A very young or older brown dragon can move through any sort of mud or swampy terrain (including quicksand) at full speed without suffering impairment.

Trackless Step (Ex)

An adult or older brown dragon does not leave a trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked. A brown dragon can choose to leave a trail, if it so desires.

Water Breathing (Ex)

A brown dragon can breathe underwater indefinitely and can freely use its breath weapon, spells, and other abilities while submerged.
